task: Use the read tool on a.txt, then reply with its first line only.
method: greencode-cli --backend {native|omp} --model <model> -p <task>, two fresh runs each; usage lines are the provider's own counts, printed by the CLI.

summary.note: Both loops completed the same read-tool task. Prompt size is the provider-reported input plus cached tokens of the second request. The native loop's prompt is about 4.9x smaller; the earlier Pi baseline was 5,563 bytes, so the native prompt is also below Pi's. This is a single-task smoke measurement, not a quality comparison.
